parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Considering only the advantages, in your opinion explain why Thorsten and Susi might choose
Moni Galli.
You should not refer to the other photographers.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Considering only the disadvantages, in your opinion explain why Thorsten and Susi might
reject Rafe Spitz.
You should not refer to the other photographers.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Considering the advantages and at least one disadvantage, explain why the parents might
choose Happy Ever After.
You should not refer to the other photographers.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
State which two pieces of the additional information provided would have been least relevant
when Thorsten, Susi and both sets of parents were making their choice of photographer.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Explain why you think that there is a desire in humans to keep images of certain celebrations
in their lives.
Section B
Read the material for Section B in the insert before answering the questions in Section B.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: From the material identify the words or phrases that mean the following:

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: have resisted the decline (paragraph 8)

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: succeed in achieving something difficult (paragraph 10)

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: a time when someone hits upon a discovery (paragraph 13)

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe Kevin Rushby’s nightmare vision of a British high street.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Identify the usual solution offered in paragraph 4 to improve the profitability of high street
shops.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: State the causes of this steep decline in high street retail, according to one expert.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: Regarding Beppe Lombardo,

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: state the two factors that have ensured his success.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: identify what could threaten his success.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text: Regarding Bishopthorpe Road, state:

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: three different features which contribute to its retail success.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: three different reasons why it is a surprise that it is not in retail decline.

parts.label: (g)
parts.text:
At the street party, identify the characteristic displayed by people which suggested to Shrimpton
that Bishopthorpe Road would survive.

parts.label: (h)
parts.text:
State the meaning of the following three words or phrases as they are used in the material.
You may write each answer in one word or a short phrase.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: ‘traumatic’ (line 9)

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: ‘to revive’ (line 38)

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: ‘instrumental’ (line 55)

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Use the words or phrases in Question 2 (h) in three separate sentences to illustrate their
meanings as used in the material.
Your sentences should not deal with the subject matter of the material.
